items.title_cn: 中国DeepSeek引发AI股广泛抛售，市场震荡
items.title_en: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
items.summary_cn: 中国AI公司DeepSeek的突破性进展引发全球AI概念股广泛抛售，市场担忧技术竞争格局生变。本文深入分析此次震荡的导火索、受影响板块及投资者情绪变化，揭示AI赛道从狂热转向理性重估的关键信号，值得关注后续产业链连锁反应。
items.summary_en: A breakthrough by Chinese AI firm DeepSeek triggered a broad sell-off in global AI-related stocks, raising concerns over a shifting competitive landscape. This article analyzes the catalysts, affected sectors, and changing investor sentiment, highlighting a key signal of the AI sector transitioning from frenzy to rational repricing. The subsequent chain reactions across the industry chain warrant close attention.

items.title_cn: Comex黄金与白银期货收低
items.title_en: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
items.summary_cn: Comex黄金和白银期货周五收低，因美元走强及美联储官员鹰派言论削弱了贵金属的吸引力。分析师指出，金价在连续上涨后出现技术性回调，而白银则受到工业需求预期降温的拖累。值得关注的是，尽管短期承压，但地缘政治风险和央行购金需求仍为金价提供潜在支撑，投资者需留意下周美联储会议纪要及通胀数据对市场情绪的指引。
items.summary_en: Comex gold and silver futures settled lower on Friday as a stronger dollar and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials dampened the appeal of precious metals. Analysts noted that gold saw a technical pullback after a recent rally, while silver was weighed down by cooling expectations for industrial demand. Notably, despite short-term pressure, geopolitical risks and central bank gold purchases continue to provide underlying support for gold prices. Investors should watch next week's Fed meeting minutes and inflation data for market sentiment cues.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek 不会击沉美国 AI 巨头
items.title_en: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
items.summary_cn: 本文深入分析 DeepSeek 的崛起是否真的威胁美国 AI 巨头。作者指出，尽管 DeepSeek 以低成本、高性能模型引发市场震动，但其技术路径与商业生态仍难以撼动美国巨头在算力、数据、应用场景上的结构性优势。文章提醒投资者避免过度反应，并强调竞争将推动行业创新而非零和博弈。值得一读，因为它理性拆解了市场恐慌背后的逻辑，提供了冷静的财经视角。
items.summary_en: This article examines whether DeepSeek's rise truly threatens U.S. AI giants. The author argues that despite DeepSeek's low-cost, high-performance models causing market jitters, its technology path and business ecosystem still struggle to challenge the structural advantages of U.S. titans in computing power, data, and application scenarios. The piece cautions investors against overreaction and highlights that competition will drive innovation rather than a zero-sum game. A worthwhile read for its rational deconstruction of market panic and calm financial perspective.

items.title_cn: 金融服务综述：市场观察
items.title_en: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
items.summary_cn: 该内容为金融服务领域的市场动态综述，汇集了行业要闻与专家观点。摘要需基于实际内容提炼，但原文未提供具体细节，因此建议读者关注其中对市场趋势的即时分析与关键数据，以把握金融板块的短期波动与长期走向。
items.summary_en: This content is a roundup of market updates in the financial services sector, gathering industry news and expert commentary. The summary should be based on the actual content, but since the original text lacks specific details, readers are advised to focus on the real-time analysis of market trends and key data to grasp short-term fluctuations and long-term directions in the financial sector.

items.title_cn: 美哥关税争端推动阿拉比卡咖啡价格创历史新高
items.title_en: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
items.summary_cn: 美国与哥伦比亚之间的关税争端导致阿拉比卡咖啡价格飙升至历史最高水平。作为全球最大的咖啡生产国之一，哥伦比亚的出口受阻引发市场对供应短缺的担忧，叠加全球需求旺盛和库存偏低，咖啡价格持续走高。这一动态值得关注，因为它直接影响全球咖啡产业链、消费者成本以及相关金融衍生品市场，并可能加剧食品通胀压力。
items.summary_en: A tariff dispute between the U.S. and Colombia has driven Arabica coffee prices to a record high. As one of the world's largest coffee producers, Colombia's export disruptions have raised concerns about supply shortages, compounded by strong global demand and low inventories, pushing prices further up. This development is noteworthy because it directly affects the global coffee supply chain, consumer costs, and related financial derivatives markets, and could exacerbate food inflation pressures.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek消息提振避险需求，瑞郎与日元走强
items.title_en: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
items.summary_cn: DeepSeek相关消息引发市场避险情绪升温，瑞郎和日元作为传统避险货币应声上涨。这一动态值得关注，因为它反映了市场对人工智能领域不确定性可能波及金融稳定的担忧，以及在地缘政治与科技竞争交织背景下，资金正加速流向安全资产。投资者需警惕避险情绪蔓延对风险资产和汇率市场的连锁反应。
items.summary_en: News related to DeepSeek has heightened market risk aversion, driving up the Swiss franc and Japanese yen as traditional safe-haven currencies. This development is noteworthy as it reflects concerns that uncertainties in the AI sector could spill over into financial stability, and that capital is accelerating toward safe assets amid intertwined geopolitical and technological competition. Investors should watch for contagion effects of risk aversion on risk assets and currency markets.

items.title_cn: 天气预测变化致天然气价格下跌
items.title_en: Natural Gas Falls on Shifting Weather Forecasts
items.summary_cn: 文章分析了天然气价格因天气预测调整而下跌的现象。核心洞察在于：天气预报的微小变化如何迅速传导至能源市场，凸显了天气因素对短期天然气定价的关键影响。值得关注的是，这反映了市场对供需预期的敏感性和波动性，投资者需密切跟踪气象数据以把握交易时机。
items.summary_en: The article analyzes the decline in natural gas prices driven by shifting weather forecasts. The key insight is how minor changes in weather predictions rapidly transmit to energy markets, highlighting the critical impact of weather on short-term natural gas pricing. It is worth noting that this reflects market sensitivity and volatility to supply-demand expectations, and investors need to closely track meteorological data to seize trading opportunities.

items.title_cn: 建材分销商QXO对Beacon发起敌意收购
items.title_en: Building-Products Distributor QXO Launches Hostile Bid for Beacon
items.summary_cn: 建材分销领域再现敌意收购。QXO公司绕过Beacon董事会直接向股东发起收购要约，凸显行业整合加速与资本博弈升级。此举可能引发竞购战或代理权争夺，值得关注其是否重塑分销行业格局，以及Beacon的防御策略与股东反应。
items.summary_en: A hostile takeover bid has emerged in the building-products distribution sector. QXO has launched a tender offer directly to Beacon's shareholders, bypassing the board, highlighting accelerating industry consolidation and escalating capital battles. This move could trigger a bidding war or proxy fight, and it is worth watching whether it reshapes the distribution landscape, as well as Beacon's defensive strategy and shareholder response.

items.title_cn: 旧金山联储主席戴利：美国人正身处“高通胀的跑步机”上，进一步加息可能性大
items.title_en: Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation' and more rate hikes are likely, Fed's Daly says
items.summary_cn: 旧金山联储主席戴利将周五的非农就业报告称为“美国工人的好消息”，但同时警告通胀正持续挤压家庭财务。她以“高通胀的跑步机”作比喻，暗示美联储可能进一步加息以遏制物价压力。此番表态值得关注，因为它来自美联储核心决策层，直接传递了政策信号：即使就业市场强劲，抗通胀仍是首要任务，利率路径可能比市场预期更鹰派，影响未来借贷成本与资产价格。
items.summary_en: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly called Friday's jobs report 'good news for American workers' but warned that inflation is squeezing household finances. Using the metaphor of a 'treadmill of high inflation,' she signaled that further rate hikes are likely to curb price pressures. This is worth watching because it comes from a core Fed policymaker, directly conveying a policy signal: even with a strong job market, fighting inflation remains the top priority, and the rate path may be more hawkish than markets expect, affecting future borrowing costs and asset prices.

items.title_cn: AI“信用卡”成本攀升：CoreWeave债券收益率突破16%
items.title_en: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
items.summary_cn: CoreWeave债券收益率突破16%，凸显AI债务市场承压，投资者担忧数据中心建设放缓。这一信号值得关注：它可能预示AI基础设施热潮的拐点，高杠杆参与AI算力竞赛的企业将面临再融资风险，进而影响整个科技产业链的资本开支节奏。
items.summary_en: CoreWeave's bond yield surpassing 16% highlights stress in AI debt markets as investors worry about a data center slowdown. This signal is worth watching: it may indicate a turning point in the AI infrastructure boom, with highly leveraged players in the AI compute race facing refinancing risks that could affect capex pacing across the tech supply chain.

items.title_en: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Moderna, Airbnb, Cloudflare, Affirm & more
items.summary_cn: 盘前交易揭示市场情绪与个股催化剂。本文汇总Moderna、Airbnb、Cloudflare、Affirm等公司盘前最大波动，涵盖财报、指引、合作或宏观事件驱动。投资者可快速捕捉开盘前关键信号，识别潜在交易机会与风险，为当日策略提供参考。

items.title_cn: 纳斯达克指数跌入回调区间——历史走势揭示后续常见剧本
items.title_en: Nasdaq drops into correction territory — here’s what typically happens next
items.summary_cn: 纳斯达克综合指数正式进入回调区间（较近期高点下跌超10%），引发市场对后续走势的高度关注。本文梳理历史数据，揭示指数在回调后的典型表现：短期波动加剧，但中长期往往伴随反弹机会。对于投资者而言，理解这一历史规律有助于避免情绪化决策，把握潜在布局窗口。尤其在科技股主导的纳指上，回调后的修复节奏与宏观环境、盈利预期密切相关，值得深入研判。
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq Composite has officially entered correction territory (down more than 10% from its recent high), drawing intense focus on what comes next. This article reviews historical data to reveal typical post-correction patterns: short-term volatility tends to rise, while medium- to long-term rebounds often follow. For investors, understanding these historical tendencies can help avoid emotional decisions and identify potential entry points. Given the tech-heavy nature of the Nasdaq, the pace of recovery after a correction is closely tied to macro conditions and earnings expectations, making it a key area for deeper analysis.

items.title_cn: 中期选举大胜后，民主党高层呼吁收紧AI基建：'立即暂停国家数据中心建设'
items.title_en: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
items.summary_cn: 2026年美国中期选举后，民主党获胜者与进步派议员迅速将矛头指向AI基础设施扩张，公开呼吁全国暂停数据中心建设。这一动向值得关注，因为它标志着AI监管从算法伦理转向物理基建限制，可能重塑科技巨头的算力布局与能源政策，并成为两党博弈的新焦点。
items.summary_en: After the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, Democratic winners and progressive lawmakers have swiftly targeted AI infrastructure expansion, publicly calling for a national moratorium on data center construction. This development merits attention as it signals a shift in AI regulation from algorithm ethics to physical infrastructure limits, potentially reshaping tech giants' compute strategies and energy policies, and emerging as a new focal point in partisan debate.

items.title_cn: 巴尔金预计将加息但步伐渐进
items.title_en: Barkin sees interest rate hikes ahead, but at a gradual pace
items.summary_cn: 里士满联储主席巴尔金在CNBC采访中表达了对通胀的担忧，并指出货币政策需要调整，预计未来将加息但步伐渐进。这一表态值得关注，因为它暗示美联储在应对通胀的同时，可能采取更为谨慎的紧缩路径，以平衡经济风险。巴尔金的观点为市场提供了关于未来政策节奏的重要线索，有助于投资者预判利率走向。
items.summary_en: Richmond Fed President Barkin expressed concern over inflation in a CNBC interview, stating that monetary policy will need to adjust and that interest rate hikes are expected but at a gradual pace. This is noteworthy as it suggests the Fed may take a more cautious tightening path to balance economic risks while addressing inflation. Barkin's comments provide important clues on the future policy pace, helping investors anticipate interest rate trends.

These moves often reflect company news, earnings, or industry developments, offering early signals of market sentiment and potential trading opportunities for the day. Watching these stocks can help investors gauge the day's market direction and key pre-open dynamics.

items.title_cn: 民主党中期选举大胜对中美关系意味着什么
items.title_en: What the Democratic midterms sweep changes for U.S.-China relations
items.summary_cn: 民主党在中期选举中的横扫式胜利，正重塑华盛顿的政治版图，也给中美关系带来新的变数。分析人士指出，特朗普维持脆弱贸易休战的能力面临更大风险——国内政治掣肘可能削弱其谈判授权，而民主党对华强硬立场或使贸易协议更难落地。值得关注的是，这一政治变局将如何影响两国在关税、科技管制与供应链等关键议题上的博弈节奏，为理解未来中美互动提供重要窗口。
items.summary_en: The Democratic midterms sweep is reshaping Washington's political landscape and introducing new variables into U.S.-China relations. Analysts note growing risks around President Donald Trump's ability to maintain a fragile trade truce—domestic political constraints may weaken his negotiating mandate, while Democrats' tough stance on China could make a trade deal harder to seal. How this political shift affects the two countries' maneuvering on tariffs, tech controls, and supply chains offers a key window into the future of U.S.-China engagement.

items.title_cn: 金价跌破4000美元关口之际 中国央行连续12个月增持黄金
items.title_en: China Extends Gold-Buying Streak to Two Years as Prices Drop
items.summary_cn: 中国央行10月继续增持黄金储备，将本轮购金周期延长至整整两年。当月金价下跌近7%，跌破每盎司4000美元的关键支撑位。这一操作值得关注：在金价回调之际仍坚持买入，凸显央行储备多元化与去美元化配置的长期战略定力，而非短期价格博弈；同时也为市场提供了重要底部信号参考，表明官方需求对金价形成结构性支撑。投资者可据此判断黄金中长期配置价值与全球储备格局演变趋势。
items.summary_en: China's central bank added to its gold reserves again in October, extending its current buying streak to a full two years. The move came as gold prices fell nearly 7% during the month, slipping below the key $4,000-per-ounce support threshold. This is noteworthy: by continuing to buy through a price pullback, the central bank signals a long-term strategic commitment to reserve diversification and de-dollarization rather than short-term price speculation. It also offers markets a meaningful floor signal, showing that official demand provides structural support for gold. Investors can use this to gauge gold's medium- to long-term allocation value and the shifting landscape of global reserves.

items.title_cn: 中方誓言反击美国对中国企业的制裁
items.title_en: Beijing Vows to Hit Back Against US Sanctions on China Companies
items.summary_cn: 中国商务部周六表示，强烈反对美国因两家中国企业与第三方交易而对其施加制裁，并保留采取“必要措施”维护自身利益的权利。此番表态凸显中美经贸摩擦持续升级，中方反制措施可能涉及相关美国实体，值得关注后续具体行动及其对双边关系与全球供应链的影响。
items.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce said on Saturday that it strongly opposes US sanctions on two Chinese companies over their dealings with a third party and reserves the right to take 'necessary measures' to protect its interests. The statement highlights escalating Sino-US trade tensions, with potential countermeasures targeting US entities, and warrants attention for subsequent actions and their impact on bilateral relations and global supply chains.

items.title_cn: 一起银行丑闻如何扳倒特朗普在巴拉圭的盟友
items.title_en: How a Bank Scandal Is Taking Down Trump’s Ally in Paraguay
items.summary_cn: 美洲开发银行投资部门在踏入巴拉圭Ueno银行后不久便察觉异常，由此牵出一桩金融丑闻。该案不仅关乎银行治理与合规漏洞，更直指巴拉圭政商网络：Ueno银行与特朗普盟友、前总统奥拉西奥·卡特斯关系密切。丑闻可能重塑巴拉圭政治格局，并影响美国在该地区的利益布局。值得关注的是，跨国金融机构的尽职调查如何成为揭露政治腐败的突破口，以及这一事件对特朗普阵营海外盟友网络的连锁冲击。
items.summary_en: Officials at the Inter-American Development Bank's investment arm sensed something was wrong shortly after entering Paraguay's Ueno Bank SA, unraveling a financial scandal. The case goes beyond bank governance and compliance failures, pointing directly at Paraguay's political-business network: Ueno Bank is closely tied to Horacio Cartes, a Trump ally and former president. The scandal could reshape Paraguay's political landscape and affect U.S. interests in the region. It is worth watching how multinational financial institutions' due diligence becomes a breakthrough in exposing political corruption, and the ripple effects on Trump's network of overseas allies.

items.title_cn: The Corner Store携纽约体验登陆拉斯维加斯大道
items.title_en: The Corner Store Brings Its New York Experience to the Las Vegas Strip
items.summary_cn: Catch Hospitality Group将在拉斯维加斯Cosmopolitan开设The Corner Store分店。联合创始人Eugene Remm表示，这家150座餐厅将保留纽约原店75座的私密感和纯正SoHo体验，而非推出拉斯维加斯特供版或稀释版。这一扩张策略值得关注：在连锁餐饮普遍为迎合本地市场而调整产品的背景下，该品牌选择逆势坚守原汁原味，考验的是消费者对“真实纽约体验”的付费意愿，也为高端餐饮跨城市复制提供了差异化样本。
items.summary_en: Catch Hospitality Group is opening a Las Vegas location of The Corner Store at the Cosmopolitan. Co-Founder Eugene Remm says the 150-seat restaurant will preserve the intimacy and authentic SoHo experience of its 75-seat New York original, rather than offer a Vegas-specific or watered-down version. This expansion strategy is noteworthy: as chain restaurants typically adapt products to local markets, the brand chooses to stay true to its roots, testing consumers' willingness to pay for an authentic New York experience and offering a differentiated model for replicating upscale dining across cities.

items.title_cn: Elanco第三季度业绩超预期并上调全年指引，股价大涨近8%
items.title_en: Elanco Shares Jump After Q3 Beat and Outlook Raise
items.summary_cn: Elanco动物保健公司第三季度盈利超出市场预期，并上调全年业绩指引，推动股价上涨近8%。CEO杰夫·西蒙斯称这是“高质量的一个季度”，指出报告增长达11%，且各市场和产品线普遍表现强劲。该股值得关注，因其业绩全面超预期且管理层信心增强，可能预示动物保健行业需求持续复苏。
items.summary_en: Elanco Animal Health shares rose nearly 8% after the company reported third-quarter earnings above expectations and raised its full-year outlook. CEO Jeff Simmons called it a 'high-quality quarter,' citing 11% reported growth and broad strength across markets and product lines. The stock is worth watching as the broad beat and increased management confidence may signal sustained recovery in animal health demand.

items.title_cn: Sweetgreen CEO：环孢子虫疫情致客流下滑后，销售额已反弹
items.title_en: Sweetgreen CEO Says Sales Rebound After Cyclospora-Related Traffic Drop
items.summary_cn: Sweetgreen CEO Jonathan Neman透露，尽管夏季环孢子虫疫情与公司门店无关，却拖累了全行业客流；公司9月同店销售已回平，10月增长约5%，11月初进一步改善。该案例值得关注，因为它揭示了外部食品安全事件如何波及无辜品牌，以及管理层如何判断需求复苏的真实节奏。
items.summary_en: Sweetgreen CEO Jonathan Neman says that although the summer Cyclospora outbreak was unrelated to the company's stores, it hurt traffic across the sector. Comparable sales returned to flat in September, grew about 5% in October, and improved further in early November. The case is worth watching because it shows how an external food-safety event can hit unaffected brands and how management gauges the true pace of demand recovery.

items.title_cn: FIGS业绩超预期：需求远超供应，CEO特丽娜·斯皮尔解读增长动力
items.title_en: FIGS Beats Earnings as Demand Outstrips Supply, CEO Trina Spear Says
items.summary_cn: FIGS第三季度营收1.907亿美元，超出预期的1.828亿美元，连续第四个季度实现至少25%的营收增长。非手术服业务营收增长35%，国际营收也有所增加。CEO特丽娜·斯皮尔表示，医疗专业人员正将FIGS的购买范围从手术服扩展到内搭服、压缩袜和外衣等，兼顾工作与休闲穿着。这份财报凸显了FIGS在医疗服装市场的品牌延展力与需求韧性，值得关注其品类扩张战略能否持续驱动增长。
items.summary_en: FIGS reported third-quarter revenue of $190.7 million, beating the estimate of $182.8 million, marking its fourth consecutive quarter of at least 25% revenue growth. Non-scrubwear revenue rose 35%, and international revenue also increased. CEO Trina Spear said health care professionals are expanding their FIGS purchases beyond scrubs to items such as underscrubs, compression socks and outerwear for work and off-duty wear. The results highlight FIGS' brand extension power and demand resilience in the medical apparel market, making its category expansion strategy worth watching.

items.title_cn: Braskem债务谈判遇阻，股东撤回关键注资提议
items.title_en: Braskem Owners Pull Funding Offer as Debt Talks Hit Snag
items.summary_cn: 巴西化工巨头Braskem与其债权人的庭外债务重组谈判陷入僵局，知情人士透露，若谈判维持现状，股东已撤回作为协议关键环节的注资提议。这一变故令本就脆弱的债务重组前景雪上加霜，凸显拉美最大石化企业面临的财务压力与治理博弈。值得关注的是，股东与债权人的分歧可能引发连锁反应，影响公司信用状况及区域金融市场稳定。
items.summary_en: Talks between Brazil's Braskem SA and its creditors over an out-of-court debt restructuring have soured, with shareholders withdrawing a proposed capital injection that was key to a deal if negotiations remain as they are, according to people familiar with the matter. The setback darkens the already fragile outlook for the restructuring, highlighting the financial strain and governance tensions at Latin America's largest petrochemical company. The rift between shareholders and creditors could trigger ripple effects on the company's credit profile and regional financial stability.

items.title_cn: 美情报称英伟达黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍高管有恋爱关系
items.title_en: US believes Nvidia’s Huang had romantic relationship with alleged Chinese spy
items.summary_cn: 美国情报部门警告称，英伟达CEO黄仁勋与一名被中国招募、负责搜集美国公司信息的高管存在恋爱关系。此消息若属实，将涉及全球最具价值芯片公司的核心人物与国家安全风险的交织，凸显中美科技竞争背景下商业领袖面临的间谍指控敏感性。事件可能影响英伟达在华业务及美国对华技术出口管制执行，值得关注后续调查与官方回应。
items.summary_en: US intelligence has warned that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with an executive recruited by China to gather information on the US company. If true, the allegation intertwines the head of the world's most valuable chipmaker with national security risks, highlighting the sensitivity of espionage accusations against business leaders amid US-China tech competition. The development could affect Nvidia's China operations and US export control enforcement, warranting attention to follow-up investigations and official responses.

items.title_cn: 美国警告中国必须“立即”履行釜山贸易协议条款
items.title_en: US warns China it must ‘immediately’ meet terms of Busan trade deal
items.summary_cn: 华盛顿指责北京未兑现增加稀土及其他关键产品供应的承诺，并发出“立即”履行的强硬警告。此事值得关注，因为它凸显中美在关键矿产领域的博弈正从谈判转向施压，可能加剧供应链紧张并影响全球高科技与绿色产业。若双方无法弥合分歧，釜山协议框架面临破裂风险，市场需警惕相关资源价格波动及地缘政治溢价上升。
items.summary_en: Washington has accused Beijing of failing to honor its commitments to increase supplies of rare earths and other critical products, issuing a stark warning to comply 'immediately.' This matters because it shows the U.S.-China contest over critical minerals is shifting from negotiation to coercion, potentially intensifying supply chain strains and affecting global high-tech and green industries. If the gap persists, the Busan deal framework risks unraveling, and markets should watch for price volatility in related resources and rising geopolitical premiums.

items.title_cn: 詹姆斯·塔拉里科：凭信仰与反腐主张让得州翻蓝的民主党新星
items.title_en: James Talarico: the Democrats’ rising star who turned Texas blue
items.summary_cn: 37岁的塔拉里科将基督教信仰与反腐讯息结合，为民主党赢得数十年来首个全州性胜利。他的崛起揭示了在深红州以道德叙事而非党派对立争取选民的可行路径，值得关注其模式能否复制。
items.summary_en: The 37-year-old Talarico combined Christian faith with an anti-corruption message to deliver Democrats their first statewide win in decades. His rise reveals a viable path in deep-red states: moral narrative over partisan confrontation. Whether this model can be replicated is worth watching.

items.title_cn: 我的投资组合从英雄变狗熊（其实归零我也愿意）
items.title_en: My portfolio returns went from hero to zero (actually I’d take zero)
items.summary_cn: 本文以自嘲口吻讲述作者亚洲基金中一只股票曾让他数月显得英明，如今却风光不再。文章生动揭示投资中运气与实力的错觉，以及回撤带来的心理落差，提醒读者警惕集中持仓的风险，并反思“归零也愿意”背后的无奈与幽默。值得一看，因为它用真实经历戳破投资自负，引发对风险管理的共鸣。
items.summary_en: In a self-deprecating tone, the author recounts how one stock in his Asia fund made him look clever for months but has now lost its shine. The piece vividly exposes the illusion of skill versus luck in investing and the psychological sting of drawdowns, warning readers about the risks of concentrated positions while reflecting on the irony behind 'I’d take zero.' It’s worth reading for its honest take on investment hubris and its resonance with risk management.

items.title_cn: 特朗普的关税政策已向世界证明：关税无用
items.title_en: Trump has taught the world that tariffs are useless
items.summary_cn: 文章以美国中期选举中共和党惨败为切入点，指出无脑保护主义政策带来了沉重的经济与政治代价。作者认为，特朗普的关税战不仅未能实现其宣称的目标，反而向全球昭示了关税作为政策工具的无效性。本文值得一读，因为它用选举结果这一硬核政治事实，为“关税无用论”提供了有力佐证，并揭示了贸易保护主义在现实政治中的反噬效应。
items.summary_en: Using the Republicans' devastating defeat in the midterm elections as a starting point, the article argues that mindless protectionism has imposed heavy economic and political costs. The author contends that Trump's tariff wars not only failed to achieve their stated goals but also demonstrated to the world the futility of tariffs as a policy tool. This piece is worth reading because it provides hard political evidence—electoral outcomes—for the argument that tariffs are useless, and reveals the blowback effect of trade protectionism in real-world politics.

items.title_cn: 特朗普任命移民强硬派斯蒂芬·米勒为幕僚长
items.title_en: Trump taps immigration hardliner Stephen Miller as chief of staff
items.summary_cn: 在共和党中期选举惨败数日后，特朗普决定撤换苏西·怀尔斯，任命移民问题强硬派斯蒂芬·米勒出任白宫幕僚长。此举标志着特朗普在选举失利后选择进一步强化其核心议程中的移民强硬路线，而非转向温和或寻求跨党派合作。米勒以推动激进移民政策著称，其任命预示白宫未来在移民执法、边境管控等议题上将采取更对抗性姿态，也可能加剧党内对选举策略的争论。这一人事变动值得关注，因为它揭示了特朗普对中期选举失败的回应逻辑——巩固基本盘而非扩大选民联盟。
items.summary_en: Days after the Republican Party's resounding midterm election defeat, Trump decided to replace Susie Wiles with immigration hardliner Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff. The move signals that after the electoral loss, Trump is doubling down on the hardline immigration agenda at the core of his platform rather than pivoting toward moderation or bipartisan outreach. Miller is known for pushing aggressive immigration policies, and his appointment suggests the White House will adopt a more confrontational stance on immigration enforcement and border control, potentially intensifying intra-party debates over election strategy. This personnel change is noteworthy because it reveals Trump's response logic to the midterm defeat—consolidating the base rather than broadening the voter coalition.

items.title_cn: 中期选举惨败后，谁将首当其冲？
items.title_en: Who is in the line of fire after the midterm drubbing?
items.summary_cn: 民主党在中期选举中大获全胜，特朗普政府正面临严峻考验。本文深入分析选举结果对白宫人事与政策走向的冲击，揭示谁将成为政治风暴中的首要目标。值得一看，因为它清晰勾勒了权力格局变化下的风险焦点。
items.summary_en: The Democratic Party's emphatic victory in the US midterms has put the Trump administration under intense scrutiny. This article analyzes the election's impact on White House staffing and policy direction, revealing who will be the primary target in the political storm. Worth reading for a clear picture of the risk focal points amid shifting power dynamics.

items.title_cn: Anthropic拟推进IPO，目标估值1.5万亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic to press ahead with IPO targeting $1.5tn valuation
items.summary_cn: Claude开发商Anthropic计划在感恩节前上市，目标估值高达1.5万亿美元，尽管科技股正经历残酷抛售。这一举动值得关注，因为它将检验市场对AI明星企业的真实信心，尤其是在行业估值泡沫争议与宏观逆风并存的背景下。若成功，可能为后续AI公司上市铺路；若遇冷，则预示资本对高估值AI资产的审慎转向。
items.summary_en: Claude maker Anthropic intends to list before Thanksgiving, targeting a $1.5tn valuation despite a brutal tech rout. This is worth watching as it will test genuine market confidence in AI star companies amid debates over industry valuation bubbles and macro headwinds. Success could pave the way for other AI IPOs; a cold reception would signal a cautious shift in capital toward high-valuation AI assets.

items.title_cn: Crusoe将困境中的怀俄明州数据中心项目出售给谷歌
items.title_en: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
items.summary_cn: Crusoe Energy将其在怀俄明州陷入困境的大型AI数据中心项目出售给谷歌，交易凸显了开发大规模AI数据中心所面临的严峻挑战，包括电力供应、基础设施建设和项目融资等难题。这一案例值得关注，因为它揭示了AI算力扩张背后的现实瓶颈，以及科技巨头如何通过收购方式绕过开发风险，加速自身AI基础设施布局。
items.summary_en: Crusoe Energy has sold its troubled large-scale AI data center project in Wyoming to Google, highlighting the significant challenges of developing massive AI data centers, including power supply, infrastructure construction, and project financing. This case is noteworthy because it reveals the real-world bottlenecks behind AI compute expansion and how tech giants are bypassing development risks through acquisitions to accelerate their AI infrastructure deployment.

items.title_cn: OpenAI据悉以1.25万亿美元估值再融110亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.summary_cn: OpenAI在尚未关闭的融资轮中再获110亿美元注资，估值高达1.25万亿美元，较此前水平大幅跃升。这一动向值得关注：它不仅刷新了AI领域单轮融资纪录，更凸显资本对通用人工智能前景的极度押注。在商业化路径尚不清晰、监管压力渐增的背景下，如此高估值意味着市场对OpenAI技术垄断力和生态扩张速度的强烈预期，同时也埋下回报周期与泡沫风险的隐忧。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion in a funding round that has yet to close, at a valuation of $1.25 trillion—a dramatic jump from previous levels. This development is noteworthy: it sets a new record for single-round AI financing and underscores investors' extreme bet on the future of artificial general intelligence. With commercialization still unclear and regulatory pressure mounting, such a high valuation signals strong market expectations for OpenAI's technological dominance and ecosystem expansion, while also raising concerns about return cycles and bubble risks.

items.title_cn: 数百个Artex AI黑客工具公开暴露于互联网
items.title_en: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
items.summary_cn: 安全研究人员发现数百台托管渗透测试工具Artex的服务器暴露在互联网上，任何人均可访问该黑客工具。这一发现凸显了AI驱动攻击工具的扩散风险：原本用于安全测试的工具一旦配置不当，便可能被恶意行为者利用，降低网络攻击门槛。值得关注的是，它揭示了AI安全工具的双刃剑效应及暴露面管理的重要性。
items.summary_en: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone to access the hacking tool. This finding highlights the proliferation risk of AI-powered attack tools: tools intended for security testing, when misconfigured, can be exploited by malicious actors and lower the barrier to cyberattacks. It underscores the double-edged nature of AI security tools and the importance of exposure management.

items.title_cn: Meta推出Spaces：与Muse智能体协作的全新方式
items.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
items.summary_cn: Meta的Muse智能体再添新功能，Spaces被定位为与AI助手互动的新途径。值得关注的是，这不仅是功能叠加，更暗示Meta正将AI智能体从单点工具推向可共享、可协作的空间化交互层。若Spaces能降低多智能体协同的门槛，或将重塑个人与AI协作的工作流，成为Meta在AI代理赛道差异化竞争的关键落子。
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse agents are gaining new features and integrations, with Spaces positioned as a new way to interact with the AI helpers. What makes this worth watching is not just another feature addition, but a signal that Meta is pushing AI agents from standalone tools toward a shareable, collaborative spatial interaction layer. If Spaces can lower the barrier to multi-agent collaboration, it could reshape personal AI workflows and become a key differentiator for Meta in the AI agent race.

items.title_cn: 蓝色浪潮席卷中期选举：AI数据中心扩张遭遇最强阻力
items.title_en: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
items.summary_cn: 民主党在中期选举的历史性胜利可能重塑科技行业格局。周二，41项数据中心相关公投中，除一项外均通过限制数据中心开发的措施。即便数据中心未直接列入选票，也成为竞选议题。这表明公众对AI基础设施扩张的抵触情绪正在政治层面形成实质约束，值得关注的是，这种基层反弹可能迫使AI行业重新思考其能源与选址策略，进而影响算力扩张速度与成本结构。
items.summary_en: Democrats' historic midterm victories could reshape the tech industry. On Tuesday, 41 data center-related ballot measures were voted on — all but one passed restrictions on data center development. Even where data centers weren't directly on the ballot, they became campaign issues. This signals that public resistance to AI infrastructure expansion is translating into concrete political constraints. Notably, this grassroots pushback may force the AI industry to rethink its energy and siting strategies, potentially affecting the pace and cost structure of compute expansion.

items.title_cn: 中期选举后，AI行业会迎来艰难两年吗？
items.title_en: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
items.summary_cn: 美国中期选举中民主党大胜，可能重塑科技行业格局。周二共有41项数据中心相关公投，除一项外均通过限制数据中心开发的措施。即便数据中心未直接列入选票，也成为地方政治焦点。这预示着AI基础设施扩张面临更严监管，行业或进入增长放缓、合规成本上升的调整期，值得关注政策风向对AI算力布局的深远影响。
items.summary_en: Democrats' historic midterm victories could reshape the tech industry. Of 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday, all but one passed stricter restrictions on data center development. Even where data centers weren't directly on the ballot, they became a local political flashpoint. This signals tougher regulation for AI infrastructure expansion, suggesting the industry may face slower growth and higher compliance costs—a policy shift worth watching for its far-reaching impact on AI compute deployment.

items.title_cn: Ramp数据显示AI支出停滞，Anthropic临近IPO之际市场面临考验
items.title_en: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
items.summary_cn: Ramp数据显示，AI使用量持续攀升，但相关支出却陷入停滞。大型支出方通过降价和更智能的成本控制来优化开支，这一趋势可能动摇投资者对AI超高速增长的假设。在Anthropic即将IPO的关键节点，这组数据值得关注：它揭示了AI商业化进程中“用量增长≠收入增长”的潜在矛盾，提醒市场重新审视AI行业的变现效率与增长质量。
items.summary_en: Ramp data reveals that AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Major spenders are cutting prices and adopting smarter cost controls, a trend that could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth. As Anthropic approaches its IPO, this data is worth watching: it highlights a potential contradiction in AI commercialization where 'usage growth ≠ revenue growth,' prompting the market to reassess monetization efficiency and growth quality in the AI sector.

items.title_cn: 封禁Muse后，亚马逊现允许用户发短信给Alexa协助购物
items.title_en: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
items.summary_cn: 亚马逊在封禁第三方AI购物助手Muse后，迅速推出官方替代方案：允许用户通过短信与Alexa互动完成购物。该功能将在数周内覆盖数百万用户，标志着语音助手向文本交互场景的延伸，也反映出亚马逊在AI购物入口上的控制权争夺。值得关注的是，这一举措既是对第三方插件的防御性封堵，也是将用户购物行为更深度绑定在自家生态内的战略布局，未来可能重塑对话式电商的竞争格局。
items.summary_en: After blocking the third-party AI shopping assistant Muse, Amazon has quickly launched an official alternative: allowing users to interact with Alexa via text messages to complete purchases. The feature will roll out to millions of users in the coming weeks, marking an extension of voice assistants into text-based interaction scenarios and reflecting Amazon's fight for control over the AI shopping entry point. Notably, this move is both a defensive blockade against third-party plugins and a strategic effort to bind user shopping behavior more deeply within its own ecosystem, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape of conversational commerce.

items.title_cn: 今日下载：人形机器人打扫房屋，三星为AI热潮建厂
items.title_en: The Download: a humanoid cleans house and Samsung builds for the AI boom
items.summary_cn: 本期《今日下载》带来两个值得关注的AI落地信号：一是旧金山初创公司Tau Robotics的人形机器人上门清洁服务，虽仍需远程人工操控，但已让体验者窥见未来家庭自动化的雏形；二是三星大规模新建半导体制造园区，以应对生成式AI对专用内存芯片的激增需求。两则新闻分别从消费端和基础设施端揭示了AI技术从概念走向日常生活的现实进度与瓶颈，值得关注AI商业化落地与供应链动态的读者一读。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download highlights two notable signals of AI deployment: Tau Robotics, a San Francisco startup, offers a humanoid robot cleaning service that, although still teleoperated by humans, gives a glimpse of future home automation; and Samsung is building a massive new semiconductor campus to meet surging demand for specialized memory chips driven by generative AI. Together, these stories reveal both the real-world progress and the current limits of AI moving from concept to daily life, making them essential reading for anyone tracking AI commercialization and supply chain trends.

items.title_cn: 我观看了一台人形机器人打扫我的公寓，感觉像是提前体验了未来
items.title_en: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.summary_cn: 作者以记者身份体验了旧金山Tau Robotics公司的人形机器人清洁服务。目前机器人仍由人工远程操控，通过收集数据训练自主模型。服务价格虽低（每小时30美元），但机器人动作缓慢，全程围观不如自己动手。文章揭示了当前人形机器人技术的真实水平：物理能力已具备，但自主性不足，数据积累是商业逻辑的核心。值得一读，因为它以亲历视角呈现了AI机器人从遥控到自主的过渡阶段，以及早期商业化服务的真实体验与局限。
items.summary_en: The author experienced a humanoid robot cleaning service from San Francisco startup Tau Robotics as a journalist. Currently, the robots are teleoperated by humans, collecting data to train autonomous models. Despite a low price ($30/hour), the robots are slow, making it more efficient to clean yourself if you watch the whole time. The article reveals the true state of humanoid robotics: physical capability exists, but autonomy is lacking, and data collection is the core business logic. It's worth reading for its firsthand account of the transition from teleoperation to autonomy and the real-world experience and limitations of early commercial robot services.

items.title_cn: 德州AI数据中心热潮遇冷：中期选举改写能源政策走向
items.title_en: The Download: Texas's fragile AI boom and energy policy shifts
items.summary_cn: 德州作为美国增长最快的数据中心市场，正因中期选举变天而面临不确定性。民主党候选人以数据中心议题为核心赢得关键席位，可能重塑AI基础设施扩张的监管环境。与此同时，联邦层面在特朗普任内难以推出重大气候能源立法。本文剖析选举结果如何威胁超大规模企业的德州布局，并揭示美国AI建设可能停滞的深层焦虑，值得关注科技与政策交叉领域的读者一读。
items.summary_en: Texas, the fastest-growing data center market in the US, faces uncertainty after midterm elections swept Democrats into key offices on a platform centered on data centers. The power shift could reshape regulatory conditions for AI infrastructure expansion, while federal climate and energy legislation remains unlikely under Trump. This piece examines how the election results threaten hyperscalers' ambitious Texas plans and reflects growing anxiety that America's AI buildout could stall—essential reading for those tracking the intersection of technology and policy.

items.title_cn: 美国新法案拟大幅改革能源基建审批流程，加速项目落地
items.title_en: A new bill could change how the US builds energy infrastructure
items.summary_cn: 美国参议院即将表决《两党美国可负担性与就业法案》，该法案旨在简化能源项目联邦许可流程，缩短审批时间。文章指出，现行许可制度缓慢复杂，法案虽技术中立，但关键争议在于其将削减温室气体排放还是推高排放。值得关注的是，该法案可能深刻影响美国能源基建速度与气候目标。
items.summary_en: The US Senate is set to vote on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, which aims to streamline federal permitting for energy projects and shorten approval timelines. The article notes that the current permitting system is slow and complex, and while the bill is technology-neutral, the key debate is whether it will cut greenhouse gas emissions or push them higher. It is worth watching because the bill could significantly impact the pace of US energy infrastructure and climate goals.

items.title_cn: 得州AI数据中心建设热潮或戛然而止：民主党翻蓝带来政策转向
items.title_en: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.
items.summary_cn: 得州作为美国增长最快的数据中心市场和大型科技公司AI建设重镇，正面临政策急转弯。民主党候选人赢得参议员和州长席位，并首次掌控州众议院，他们将数据中心作为核心议题。早在选举前，州长Abbott已指示监管机构暂停数据中心许可，开发商称州长办公室不再回复邮件。行业内部人士在DCD会议上感叹，得州曾是全美最容易建设数据中心的地方，但这一切在9月戛然而止。新州长Hinojosa虽曾支持税收优惠，但如今态度转变，得州AI基础设施扩张前景堪忧。
items.summary_en: Texas, the fastest-growing data center market in the US and ground zero for Big Tech's largest AI buildouts, faces a policy U-turn. Democrats won the Senate and governor seats and took control of the Texas House for the first time in 24 years, making data centers a central campaign issue. Even before polls closed, Governor Abbott had directed a key regulator to halt data center permits, and developers said his office stopped responding to emails. Industry insiders at the DCD conference lamented that Texas had been the easiest place to build for years—until September. With Governor-elect Hinojosa seemingly eager to act, the future of Texas AI infrastructure expansion is in doubt.

items.title_cn: 圆桌讨论：探索认知永生的追求
items.title_en: Roundtables: Inside the Quest for Cognitive Immortality
items.summary_cn: 本文预告了一场关于认知永生的圆桌讨论，由《麻省理工科技评论》科学编辑Mary Beth Griggs和生物医学高级编辑Antonio Regalado主持，探讨通过渐进式大脑替换和记忆上传云端等方式实现意识延续的可能性。活动将于2026年11月17日线上举行，并附有相关深度报道链接。对于关注脑科学、人工智能与未来伦理的读者，这是一次了解前沿思想碰撞的宝贵机会。
items.summary_en: This article previews a roundtable discussion on cognitive immortality, hosted by MIT Technology Review's science editor Mary Beth Griggs and senior biomedicine editor Antonio Regalado. They will explore possible paths to extend the mind beyond death, including gradual brain replacement and uploading memories to the cloud. The event takes place online on November 17, 2026, and includes links to related in-depth stories. For readers interested in neuroscience, AI, and future ethics, this is a valuable opportunity to engage with cutting-edge ideas.

items.title_cn: 美国中期选举后能源政策走向何方？
items.title_en: What’s next for US energy policy after the midterm elections?
items.summary_cn: 中期选举后民主党夺回参众两院，但特朗普仍驻白宫，形成分裂政府。文章回顾近年《通胀削减法案》与《 One Big Beautiful Bill Act》因政府统一而大幅摇摆的教训，指出联邦层面难有重大能源立法，但州和地方层面的能源气候政策将成关键战场。值得关注的是，分裂政府下能源政策将更多自下而上重塑。
items.summary_en: After the midterms, Democrats captured both the House and Senate, but Trump remains in the White House, creating divided government. The article reviews how the Inflation Reduction Act and the One Big Beautiful Bill Act swung wildly when government was unified, and argues that major federal energy legislation is unlikely now. Instead, state and local energy and climate policy will become the key battlegrounds. Worth watching: energy policy will be reshaped more from the bottom up under divided government.

items.title_cn: 今日速递：混合肉、视力恢复与智能体网络
items.title_en: The Download: blended meat, restored sight, and the agentic web
items.summary_cn: 本期《今日速递》聚焦三项前沿科技：初创公司Joyn等推出“混合肉”产品，将植物蛋白与真肉结合，试图在不牺牲口感的前提下减少红肉消费，应对气候危机；一种新型植入物有望为晚期黄斑变性患者恢复视力，覆盖全球超500万患者；此外，文章还探讨了“智能体网络”的兴起，即AI代理自主协作完成任务的下一代互联网形态。这些进展分别从食品科技、生物医疗和AI基础设施三个维度，展示了技术如何切实解决人类面临的重大挑战，值得关注。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download highlights three frontier developments: startups like Joyn are creating 'blended meat' that mixes plant proteins with real meat to cut red meat consumption without sacrificing taste, addressing the climate crisis; a new implant could restore sight for patients with advanced macular degeneration, affecting over 5 million people worldwide; and the piece explores the rise of the 'agentic web,' where AI agents autonomously collaborate to complete tasks. Together, these advances in food tech, biomedicine, and AI infrastructure show how technology is tackling major human challenges, making this a must-read.

items.title_cn: OpenAI估值达1.25万亿美元，竞争对手Anthropic临近IPO
items.title_en: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
items.summary_cn: OpenAI在新一轮融资中再筹110亿美元，估值飙升至1.25万亿美元，成为全球最有价值公司之一。此前3月刚以8520亿美元估值融资1220亿美元。彭博社称OpenAI仍在寻求额外投资，目标总额或达200亿美元，最初曾希望在1.4万亿美元估值下融资300亿美元，但科技股下跌及中期选举结果改变了市场环境。与此同时，竞争对手Anthropic正临近IPO，AI巨头资本竞赛与上市潮值得关注。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has raised another $11 billion in a new funding round, pushing its valuation to $1.25 trillion and making it one of the world's most valuable companies. This follows a $122 billion raise in March at an $852 billion valuation. Bloomberg reports OpenAI is still pursuing additional investments that could bring the total to $20 billion, having initially hoped to raise up to $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation before tech stocks dropped and midterm election results shifted the market landscape. Meanwhile, rival Anthropic is nearing its IPO, making the AI giants' capital race and listing wave worth watching.

items.title_cn: 报道称中国招募AI高管监视黄仁勋
items.title_en: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
items.summary_cn: 《纽约时报》报道称，中国国家安全部招募了Megaspeed高管Alice Huang，以刺探英伟达CEO黄仁勋及美国AI芯片情报，并可能试图影响英伟达推动对华出售最先进芯片。Megaspeed是英伟达客户，Alice Huang还与技嘉等芯片业高层有联系。此事凸显AI芯片已成为中美科技博弈的核心战场，涉及企业高管、情报活动与出口管制的复杂交织，值得关注其对英伟达对华业务及行业监管的潜在影响。
items.summary_en: The New York Times reports that China's Ministry of State Security recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and gather intelligence on American AI chips, and potentially influence the company to push for its most advanced chips to be made available to China. Megaspeed is an Nvidia customer, and Huang also has relationships with executives at the highest levels of the AI chip industry, including leaders at Gigabyte. The story highlights how AI chips have become a central battleground in US-China tech competition, involving corporate executives, intelligence activities, and export controls, and is worth watching for its potential impact on Nvidia's China business and industry regulation.

items.title_cn: AI数据中心最新动态：扩张热潮遭遇选举政治与社区阻力
items.title_en: All the latest updates on AI data centers
items.summary_cn: 本文汇总了AI数据中心建设的最新进展与争议。科技巨头将大规模数据中心视为AI发展的物理基础，但快速扩张引发了电网负荷、公用事业费用、社区影响和环境问题等多重矛盾。2026年中期选举中，数据中心成为两党议题，选民普遍反对扩张。OpenAI、亚马逊等企业承诺加强与社区合作并承担能源成本，但选举后民主党领导人呼吁进一步限制和放缓数据中心建设，AI企业将面临更严峻的政策环境。文章还涉及太空数据中心计划、地方建设冲突及碳排放等议题，值得关注AI基础设施扩张与地方政治、环境治理之间的张力。
items.summary_en: This article rounds up the latest developments and controversies surrounding AI data center buildouts. Tech giants view massive data centers as the physical foundation for AI ambitions, but rapid expansion has sparked conflicts over power grid strain, utility bills, community impact, and environmental concerns. Data centers became a major bipartisan issue ahead of the 2026 midterms, with voters largely opposing expansion at the polls. Companies like OpenAI and Amazon have promised closer community engagement and to cover energy costs, but following the election, Democratic leaders are calling for further restrictions and slowdowns that AI companies will have to grapple with. The piece also touches on audacious plans for space-based data centers, heated local buildout battles, and carbon emissions—making it essential reading on the tension between AI infrastructure expansion and local politics and environmental governance.

items.title_cn: Meta Muse AI 推出“空间”功能，可按需生成定制化应用体验
items.title_en: Meta's Muse AI can create custom 'spaces' for the version of the app you need right now
items.summary_cn: Meta 为旗下 AI 助手 Muse 推出“空间”功能，用户只需描述需求，即可生成购物中心、学校看板、音乐追踪器、问答游戏等应用化体验。连接 Gmail、Google 日历、OpenTable、Notion 等外部应用后，AI 会持续拉取信息并在后台自动更新价格、日期等内容。这标志着 AI 助手从对话工具向可定制、可交互的轻应用平台演进，值得关注其对应用生态和用户交互方式的影响。
items.summary_en: Meta has launched 'spaces' for its Muse AI assistant, letting users generate app-like experiences such as a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, or trivia game simply by describing them. When connected to external apps like Gmail, Google Calendar, OpenTable, and Notion, the AI continuously pulls information and updates pricing, dates, and other details in the background. This signals a shift from conversational assistants to customizable, interactive lightweight app platforms, making it worth watching for its impact on the app ecosystem and user interaction.

items.title_cn: AI成为约会新雷区：当科技立场变成择偶标准
items.title_en: AI is the new dating dealbreaker
items.summary_cn: 在旧金山，25岁的分析师Irene发现约会软件Hinge上出现了一种新趋势：用户开始在个人简介中明确表达对AI的反感，如“Fuck AI”。这通常来自艺术、护理和设计行业的人。文章探讨了AI态度如何成为约会中的新政治立场，反映了科技对亲密关系的渗透以及人们对AI的焦虑正在重塑社交规则。值得一看，因为它揭示了技术争议如何从公共领域进入私人生活，成为判断价值观的新标签。
items.summary_en: In San Francisco, 25-year-old analyst Irene noticed a new trend on the dating app Hinge: users are explicitly expressing anti-AI sentiments in their profiles, such as 'Fuck AI.' This often comes from people in arts, nursing, and design. The article explores how attitudes toward AI are becoming a new political stance in dating, reflecting technology's penetration into intimate relationships and how anxiety about AI is reshaping social norms. It's worth reading because it reveals how tech controversies move from public debate into private life, becoming a new label for judging values.

items.title_cn: 2026中期选举：科技巨头与AI遭遇重挫
items.title_en: Big Tech lost big in the 2026 election
items.summary_cn: 2026年美国中期选举中，选民压倒性支持民主党并反对AI，科技巨头遭遇重大政治挫败。文章深入分析选举结果对科技行业的影响：数据中心建设阻力加剧、国会可能加大对科技CEO和AI监管的施压力度，以及X平台日益封闭的右翼回音室现象。播客还探讨未来两年科技政策能否取得实质进展。值得关注的是，这场选举标志着反科技巨头运动强势回归，AI监管格局或将重塑。
items.summary_en: In the 2026 US midterm elections, voters overwhelmingly supported Democrats and opposed AI, dealing a major political blow to Big Tech. The article analyzes the election's impact on the tech industry: growing resistance to data center construction, likely congressional pressure on tech CEOs and AI regulation, and the self-quarantining right-wing echo chamber on X. The podcast also explores whether any substantive tech policy progress is achievable in the next two years. Notably, the election signals a roaring comeback for the anti-Big Tech movement, potentially reshaping the AI regulatory landscape.

items.title_cn: Akai与Moog拥抱“氛围编码”改装：inMusic开放MPC等设备底层代码
items.title_en: How Akai and Moog are embracing vibe-coded mods
items.summary_cn: inMusic宣布向改装社区开放MPC、Sample等设备的底层代码和SDK，CEO Jack O'Donnell称将提供“工具箱”让用户自由改造。此举降低变砖风险，激发创意改装，标志硬件厂商从封闭走向开放，值得关注其对音乐硬件生态的长期影响。
items.summary_en: inMusic is opening the underlying code and SDK for devices like the MPC and Sample to the modding community. CEO Jack O'Donnell says the company will provide a 'toolbox' for users to customize freely, reducing bricking risks and sparking creative mods. This marks a shift from closed to open hardware, with long-term implications for the music hardware ecosystem.

items.title_cn: 亚马逊推出Alexa短信购物功能，发条消息就能下单
items.title_en: Amazon will let you text Alexa your shopping list
items.summary_cn: 亚马逊为Alexa for Shopping新增短信购物功能：用户可通过文字描述或上传照片，让AI助手搜索商品、推荐并代为下单。这是继5月推出该购物助手后的重要延伸，瞄准了发短信比打开App更便捷的场景。此举值得关注，因为它标志着AI助手正从语音交互向异步文本交互扩展，进一步模糊了对话助手与电商入口的边界，也预示着未来购物入口可能不再依赖独立App，而是嵌入用户已有的通信习惯中。
items.summary_en: Amazon has added a text-messaging feature to Alexa for Shopping, allowing customers to describe a product or send a photo, have the AI assistant search Amazon listings, reply with recommendations, and place the order on their behalf. Building on the Alexa for Shopping experience launched in May, the feature targets moments when texting is more convenient than opening Amazon's app or website. It is worth watching because it signals AI assistants expanding from voice to asynchronous text interaction, further blurring the line between conversational assistants and e-commerce gateways—suggesting future shopping entry points may live inside users' existing messaging habits rather than standalone apps.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯：一份鉴赏
items.title_en: Martin Amis: An Appreciation
items.summary_cn: 本文是对英国著名作家马丁·艾米斯的纪念与鉴赏。文章以2007年的一张照片为引，回顾了艾米斯作为“伦敦文学小子”核心人物的崛起，剖析了他标志性的文体风格——辛辣的讽刺、对道德困境的执着探索以及对当代社会粗鄙化的敏锐捕捉。作者指出，艾米斯虽常因个人生活与言论引发争议，但其文学成就不可否认：他继承并革新了英国小说传统，以独特的黑色幽默和语言创造力，深刻描绘了晚期资本主义时代的焦虑与堕落。这篇鉴赏不仅是对一位文学巨匠的致敬，更引导读者重新审视艾米斯作品在当代文学中的持久价值与思想锋芒。
items.summary_en: This article is a memorial appreciation of the renowned British writer Martin Amis. Taking a 2007 photograph as its starting point, it traces Amis's rise as a central figure of the 'London literary brat pack,' analyzing his signature style—caustic satire, an obsession with moral dilemmas, and a keen eye for the coarsening of contemporary society. The author notes that while Amis often sparked controversy through his personal life and public statements, his literary achievements are undeniable: he inherited and reinvented the British novel tradition, using distinctive black humor and linguistic inventiveness to vividly depict the anxieties and degradations of late capitalism. This appreciation is not only a tribute to a literary giant but also an invitation to reconsider the enduring value and intellectual edge of Amis's work in contemporary literature.

items.title_cn: 书评：《NB by J.C.》，詹姆斯·坎贝尔著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘NB by J.C.,’ by James Campbell
items.summary_cn: 本书收录了詹姆斯·坎贝尔在《泰晤士文学增刊》专栏中风格各异的随笔。坎贝尔以犀利而优雅的笔触，勾勒文学界的众生相，既有对名家轶事的独到挖掘，也不乏对当代文坛现象的敏锐批评。这些文字兼具博学与趣味，为读者提供了一扇观察20世纪末至21世纪初文学文化的迷人窗口。对于热爱文学批评与出版文化的读者而言，本书是不可多得的智慧盛宴。
items.summary_en: This book collects the variegated musings of James Campbell from his column in the Times Literary Supplement. With a sharp and elegant pen, Campbell sketches the literary world, offering unique insights into anecdotes of renowned authors and incisive criticism of contemporary literary phenomena. These writings combine erudition with wit, providing a fascinating window into literary culture from the late 20th to the early 21st century. For readers who cherish literary criticism and publishing culture, this is a rare intellectual feast.

items.title_cn: 《黑暗中的火焰》：凯·雷德菲尔德·贾米森转向疗愈者
items.title_en: In ‘Fires in the Dark,’ Kay Redfield Jamison Turns to Healers
items.summary_cn: 贾米森曾以自身精神疾病经历写作，改变了许多读者的生命，却也遭遇大量退稿。新作《黑暗中的火焰》中，她将目光从患者转向疗愈者，探索治疗关系中的希望与人性。本书值得一读，因为它不仅延续了贾米森对精神疾病的深刻洞察，更以疗愈者的视角重新审视痛苦与康复的复杂交织，为身处黑暗的人点燃理解与共情的火焰。
items.summary_en: Jamison once wrote about her own experience with mental illness, changing readers' lives while facing much rejection. In 'Fires in the Dark,' she shifts her focus from patients to healers, exploring hope and humanity in the therapeutic relationship. This book is worth reading because it extends Jamison's deep insight into mental illness and reexamines the complex interplay of suffering and recovery through the healer's lens, igniting a flame of understanding and empathy for those in darkness.

items.title_cn: 侦探小说《谁的尸体？》百年诞辰：多萝西·L·塞耶斯的经典之作
items.title_en: The Detective Novel ‘Whose Body?,’ by Dorothy L. Sayers, Turns 100
items.summary_cn: 多萝西·L·塞耶斯1923年出版的《谁的尸体？》迎来百年诞辰。这部作品塑造了贵族侦探彼得·温西勋爵，并以其幽默、智性和对社会问题的关注，重新定义了侦探小说。塞耶斯是侦探俱乐部的创始成员之一，该俱乐部由犯罪作家组成，旨在提升类型文学的地位。本书不仅情节精巧，更深入探讨了人性与道德，值得推理迷和文学爱好者重温。
items.summary_en: Dorothy L. Sayers's 1923 novel 'Whose Body?' celebrates its centenary. Introducing aristocratic detective Lord Peter Wimsey, the book redefined detective fiction with its wit, intelligence, and social commentary. Sayers was a founding member of the Detection Club, a society of crime writers aimed at elevating the genre. With its intricate plot and exploration of human nature and morality, this classic is worth revisiting for mystery fans and literary enthusiasts alike.

items.title_cn: 书评：《堂卡斯穆罗》，马查多·德·阿西斯著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘Dom Casmurro,’ by Machado de Assis
items.summary_cn: 这部小说通过不可靠叙述者布拉斯·库巴斯的自白，讲述了一段因嫉妒而毁灭的爱情。马查多·德·阿西斯以精妙的细节和大师级的模糊性，迫使读者在字里行间寻找真相。本书不仅是一部关于猜忌的杰作，更是一堂关于阅读与重读的文学课——每一次重读都会颠覆你的判断，让你质疑记忆、证据与叙事的本质。值得所有热爱文学的人反复品味。
items.summary_en: Through the unreliable confession of narrator Brás Cubas, this novel tells a love story destroyed by jealousy. Machado de Assis, with precise detail and masterly obfuscation, forces readers to search for truth between the lines. More than a masterpiece about suspicion, it is a literary lesson in reading and rereading—each reread overturns your judgment and makes you question memory, evidence, and the nature of narrative. Worth savoring repeatedly by all lovers of literature.

items.title_cn: 书评：《晚来的人》，布兰登·泰勒著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘The Late Americans,’ by Brandon Taylor
items.summary_cn: 布兰登·泰勒的新作《晚来的人》以爱荷华城为背景，描绘了一群居民——有的享有特权，有的没有，但都意识到自己的可能性正在收缩。小说敏锐地捕捉了当代年轻人面对阶层、欲望与艺术追求的焦虑，笔触细腻而犀利。泰勒延续了《现实生活》中对身份与亲密关系的探索，将目光投向更广阔的社会图景，揭示出在看似自由的环境中，人们如何被无形的结构所限制。这部作品值得一读，因为它不仅是一部关于成长的小说，更是一面映照当下社会困境的镜子。
items.summary_en: Brandon Taylor’s new novel, *The Late Americans*, is set in Iowa City and follows a group of residents—some privileged, some not, but all aware that their possibilities are contracting. With keen and sharp prose, Taylor captures the anxieties of contemporary young people grappling with class, desire, and artistic ambition. Continuing the exploration of identity and intimacy from his debut *Real Life*, Taylor turns his gaze to a broader social landscape, revealing how people are constrained by invisible structures even in seemingly free environments. This book is worth reading not only as a novel of coming-of-age but also as a mirror reflecting the dilemmas of our time.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯最佳书籍指南
items.title_en: Martin Amis’s Best Books: A Guide
items.summary_cn: 马丁·艾米斯逝世后，这份指南回顾了他15部小说中的精华。艾米斯以机智和语言创造力著称，作品深刻剖析当代生活。指南帮助读者理解其文学遗产，为何他的作品值得阅读：从《金钱》到《伦敦场地》，每一部都展现了他独特的讽刺才华和对人性阴暗面的敏锐洞察。对于文学爱好者而言，这是探索艾米斯世界的理想起点。
items.summary_en: Following Martin Amis's death, this guide revisits the highlights of his 15 novels. Known for his wit and linguistic ingenuity, Amis's work offers a profound critique of contemporary life. The guide helps readers understand his literary legacy and why his books are worth reading: from Money to London Fields, each showcases his unique satirical talent and keen insight into the darker sides of human nature. For literature lovers, this is an ideal starting point to explore Amis's world.

items.title_en: The Best Romance Novels of 2024 (So Far)
items.summary_cn: 这篇书单精选了2024年迄今最性感、最令人心动的浪漫小说，为寻求逃离现实的读者提供完美选择。文章不仅推荐了多部作品，还解释了每本书的独特魅力——从甜蜜的邂逅到炽热的激情，涵盖多种子类型。无论你是浪漫小说老读者还是新手，这份清单都能帮你找到下一本让你彻夜难眠的爱情故事，值得一看因为它节省了筛选时间并保证了阅读乐趣。
items.summary_en: This reading list curates the sexiest and swooniest romance novels of 2024 so far, offering perfect escapes for readers seeking an immersive love story. It recommends multiple titles and explains each book's unique appeal—from sweet meet-cutes to fiery passion—covering various subgenres. Whether you're a longtime romance fan or a newcomer, this list helps you find your next page-turner that will keep you up all night. It's worth reading because it saves you time filtering options and guarantees reading pleasure.
